name: task-rename
title: Add task.py rename that rewrites identity fields and back-references atomically
description: task.py has no rename subcommand, so renaming a task is a hand-edited multi-file operation across the directory name, task.json identity fields, parent/children back-references, jsonl context paths, and journal citations, and a partial hand-rename leaves dangling references the preflight gates then reject; add a rename command that rewrites all of these atomically with a dry-run mode; relocated from the sd-ai-command-pack upstream handoff register (08-07-upstream-task-rename, parked pack-side).
creator: sdelmas
